notes: 24 answer-only cases, three repeats each; Q20 installation execution excluded.
Q11 and Q23 are explicit advisory questions, not fixture-based privacy/injection tests.
Q02 signed-out/expired/backend-down variants are excluded. Q09 uses the actual runtime context; no static-only fixture is installed.
Historical browser pass lacks a byte-for-byte prompt manifest and counted Q20 as an answer; do not claim exact paired equivalence.
